task: #184 -- voice distinctiveness as a combat-legibility channel
premise: Voice is an INFORMATION channel, not decoration. The success metric is 'can a player tell by ear alone WHICH champion just acted, without looking', so the property being optimised is SEPARATION. Sounding like the source character is the means (a familiar voice is placed instantly), not the end.

method.architecture: A register x timbre GRID. 48 champions cannot all be >=2 semitones apart in register -- that would need ~94 semitones and human speech in this material spans ~34. So register alone caps out around 17 mutually-separated identities. The plan therefore places each champion in a cell of (register band x timbre family) and requires every PAIR to differ in register by >=2 semitones OR to sit in different timbre families.
method.gateConsistency: The baseline's own gate (doc S7) already reads as an OR -- '|dF0| >= 2 semitones, UNLESS cosine is already <= 0.40'. This plan builds in that same direction: two champions may share a register band only when they sit in different timbre families, which is the design-time stand-in for 'cosine will come out low'. Nothing in the baseline gate is relaxed here. What IS new is the arithmetic showing register alone cannot carry 48 champions, so timbre family must do the work inside a band.

timbreFamilies.clear: CLEAR -- clean modal phonation, no added texture
timbreFamilies.breath: BREATH -- audible air in the tone, soft attack
timbreFamilies.nasal: NASAL -- forward mask placement, honky ring
timbreFamilies.hollow: HOLLOW -- dark, wide chest resonance, long tail

method.thirdAxis: Delivery/tone is a SECOND spreadable axis driven by the instruct channel (CosyVoice inference_instruct2), and lexical identity -- the catchphrase itself -- is the strongest cue of all and is scored by no acoustic metric. Both are recorded per champion below.

anchorBank.what: data/blizzard-overlay/sounds -- the same corpus the baseline calibrated on. Embedded here with the same campplus pipeline so anchor picks are MEASURED, not asserted.
anchorBank.provenance: Blizzard-owned audio, DEV-only gated overlay (tasks #10/#177). Used here as an ACOUSTIC TARGET -- a description of a sound a later lane should find or record -- not as a shipping clone source. Anything cloned directly from it inherits the same gating.

centroidCalibration.note: Centroid (multi-clip) cosine is NOT on the same scale as the baseline's per-clip cosine; averaging clips removes within-speaker noise and inflates similarity. Re-derived here by split-half.
centroidCalibration.finding: EER drops 21.8% (single clip) -> 12.0% (averaged clips). A reference built from SEVERAL short clips is a materially better identity than one long clip -- worth reflecting in the dropbox rules.

anchorBank.result: 29 soundsets reduce to 20 MUTUALLY DISTINCT anchors at the calibrated 0.792 crossover; 9 are redundant (worst: Wendigo~ObsidianStatue 0.919, Thrall~Peon 0.851, Banshee~DarkRanger 0.843). So even a professionally cast 28-actor RTS roster only yields ~20 separable identities -- 20 of the 48 champions can be anchored in-repo, the other 28 need external references.
